description: This file defines a template class `RecorderType` within the `Thunder::Core` namespace, which implements a data recording mechanism with delta compression for time and value measurements. It includes nested classes for writing and reading recorded data, handling file storage, and managing measurement snapshots. The file also includes licensing information and includes several other project-specific headers.

classes.name: BaseRecorder
classes.description: A base class for recording measurements, managing internal state, and serialization/deserialization of measurement data with delta encoding.

classes.name: RecorderType<STOREVALUE, BLOCKSIZE>::Writer
classes.description: Handles writing measurement data to files, managing file rotation, and buffering.

classes.name: RecorderType<STOREVALUE, BLOCKSIZE>::Reader
classes.description: Handles reading measurement data from files, supporting navigation through recorded measurements.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement with timestamp and value, updating internal state and delta encoding.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances the internal state to the next measurement based on stored deltas.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Reverts the internal state to the previous measurement based on stored deltas.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current recording state into another recorder instance.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file into the recorder, reconstructing the internal state.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Serializes the current measurement data to a file.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.description: Resets the internal measurement data to initial state.
